item.title: Apple Watch Flags Hidden Hypertension
item.description: CHATTANOOGA, Tenn. (WDEF) – Millions of Americans live with chronic high blood pressure and don’t realize it, often because the condition shows few noticeable symptoms. Now, a new Apple Watch feature could help bring those hidden risks to light. Apple’s latest software update introduces a health metric that analyzes heart-rate data collected over time to detect patterns associated with hypertension. ...

item.title: New Option for Rare HPV Disease
item.description: CHATTANOOGA, Tenn. (WDEF) – Adults living with recurrent respiratory papillomatosis, or RRP, have long relied on surgery to manage this rare HPV-related disease.
